svg.title: What I build with
svg.desc: Automation Platforms: n8n, Make.com, Google Apps Script, HubSpot workflows, Webhooks, Selenium, Python scripting. AI & ML: LLM integration, Prompt engineering, RAG, Recommender systems, Machine learning, scikit-learn, Computer vision, Decision logic. Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML & CSS, SQL, Java, PHP, Dart, C / C++. Frameworks & Build: React, Angular, Django, Ionic, Flutter, Laravel, Vite. Data & Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, Firebase, Pinecone, Qdrant, Google Sheets, HubSpot CRM, Data modeling. Integrations & Deployment: REST APIs, Gmail, Vercel, Netlify, Capacitor, Tauri, Git. Testing & QA: Vitest, Cypress, Unit testing, Regression testing, User acceptance testing. Practices & Security: Requirements analysis, Workflow design, Problem analysis, Prototyping, Pitching, Role-based access, Documentation, Agile / Scrum.
